title: 13th Annual Hand-Painted Miniature Ornament Sale
bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden November 14, 2025

The Guild of Harwich Artists’ annual holiday miniature ornament sale is a popular attraction that raises money for two local children’s charities.  T

he hand-painted miniature ornaments will be on sale at our Art Gallery located at 551 Main Street (Rt.28) Harwich Port, MA 02645.  Gallery hours on Black Friday, 11am to 8pm and weekends through December 21, 11am to 4pm.  The Art Gallery will also be open 5-8pm during the Christmas Stroll in Harwich Port on Friday, December 5.  Public parking across the street.

Over 200 hand painted miniature oil canvases and framed watercolor paintings by members of the Guild are available at $20 each.  Many of the ornaments are inspired by holiday images of Cape Cod and make wonderful stocking stuffers. Proceeds of this year’s ornaments sale will be split between The Children’s Center, a part of Harwich Ecumenical Council for the Homeless, and the Harwich Children’s Fund.
